name: radare2 (r2pm)
description: r2pm is a package-management channel, separate from the primary radare2 updater. Its source supports Git and archive package sources; the review does not establish an independent package-signature policy or certify the original vulnerability classification.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; this review is limited to r2pm's package database/source/archive path and does not establish controls in remote repositories or package build dependencies.
